crossRefs.note: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

translations.web: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
translations.bsb: So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
translations.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
translations.asv: And the multitude went up and began to ask him to do as he was wont to do unto them.
